whatWeCollect.title: What we collect
whatWeCollect.description: {{childName}}'s name, books she writes, books she reads, and how long she reads. That's it.

whatWeNeverDo.title: What we NEVER do
items: We never show {{childName}}'s stories to anyone.

howLongWeKeep.title: How long we keep data
howLongWeKeep.description: Activity data is kept for 12 months, then automatically deleted. Books are kept until you delete the account.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.coppa: This app complies with COPPA. You control your child's data.
compliance.gdprLgpd: You have the right to access, download, and delete your child's data at any time.
